title: Type narrowing, guards, and discriminated unions — concept map
intro: typeof/in/instanceof guards, discriminated unions with exhaustiveness, user-defined predicates, assertion functions, control-flow never, and narrowing unknown at API boundaries.

overviewDiagram.title: Narrowing flow from unknown to typed

conceptCards.title: typeof, in, instanceof
conceptCards.summary: Built-in narrowing primitives. typeof for primitives. in for property check. instanceof for class prototypes.

conceptCards.title: Discriminated unions
conceptCards.summary: Literal tag per variant. switch exhaustiveness with never. Redux action pattern.

conceptCards.title: User-defined guards
conceptCards.summary: Function returning x is T. Reusable validation. Centralize boundary checks.
conceptCards.example: function isUser(x: unknown): x is User

conceptCards.title: Assertion functions
conceptCards.summary: asserts x is T — throw to narrow. assertIsDefined patterns.
conceptCards.example: function assertUser(x: unknown): asserts x is User

conceptCards.title: Control-flow never
conceptCards.summary: Compiler tracks branches. Unreachable code. Exhaustiveness default never.

conceptCards.title: unknown at API boundary
conceptCards.summary: fetch/JSON.parse to unknown. No as cast. Zod or manual guard. Redis parse.
